extension_points.name: opus.agent.runtime.result
invariants: One synchronous observation after a correlated public runtime result; descriptor registration is not runtime execution and is excluded.

Version is 1. Operation is inspect, start, suspend, resume, stop, cancel, execute, registerRuntime, unregister, retire or unknown. Status is completed, denied, failed, unavailable or unknown; only completed with a true runtime outcome has ok=true.
No identities, state, tasks, outputs, diagnostics, trace, correlation tokens or runtime metadata enter the payload.
Observer return values and payload mutation cannot alter the original result. Exceptions stop later handlers but are contained without replay.

Nested composition operations and descriptor registration across instances are denied before state access or runtime construction and do not emit another observation. The process-wide guard always resets.
Requires enabled DevElation. Idempotent requests may be observed again; delivery is best-effort, not durable audit, approval, remote-effect proof or a sandbox for installed PHP handlers.

extension_points.name: opus.command.result
invariants: One synchronous observation per admitted CommandHost call, after presentation or a host failure settles; execute, resume and CLI use the same boundary.
Version is 1. Status is completed, parsed, confirmation_required, invalid, failed or unknown. Phase is presented, processing_failed or presentation_failed.
No inputs, command objects, output, diagnostics, metadata, identities, provider errors, continuation tokens or other mutable objects enter the payload.
Observer return values and payload changes cannot alter the settled result. Exceptions stop later handlers but are contained without retry or replay.
Nested calls to any CommandHost during synchronous observation fail before processor dispatch and do not emit another observation. The process-wide guard always resets.
Requires enabled DevElation. This is best-effort observation, not durable delivery, permission, effect completion or a sandbox for installed PHP handlers.

extension_points.name: opus.addon.boot.result
invariants: One result per canonical queued registration in an engine, after registered, skipped, or failed state is settled; repeated and reentrant boot events do not redeliver.
Payload version is 1. Identity contains only persisted id, name, namespace, and version strings. Reason is a stable string for failed/skipped outcomes or null for success.
Paths, contributions, provider payloads, configuration, exceptions, and mutable internal objects are omitted.
Return values and payload mutation cannot change boot state, activation, required policy, isolation, retryability, or registration effects.
Observer exceptions stop later DevElation handlers for that delivery but cannot replace the original boot failure or turn successful/isolated boot into failure.
Dispatch requires DevElation to be enabled. There is no durable delivery, replay, automatic activation, or permission grant.

extension_points.name: opus.addon.organization.changed
invariants: State and its audit receipt are committed atomically before observers run.
Tenant ID is a string or null; actor, group, and tag content is not exposed.
Observer failures cannot roll back state or grant lifecycle or dependency authority.

extension_points.name: opus.intake.defaults
invariants: Project identity, tenant, application slug, and prompt version remain authoritative.
A missing or invalid defaults value falls back to built-in defaults.

extension_points.name: opus.intake.session.transitioned
invariants: The session is persisted before observers run.
Observer failure does not roll back the completed write.
Version 2 session contains only status and revision; answers, identity, correlation and timestamps are excluded.
Nested intake mutations across service instances are denied before repository access during synchronous observation.

extension_points.name: opus.agent.command_context
invariants: Caller identity and an explicit tenant cannot be changed.
Agent identity and host capabilities are restored from the authoritative context after filtering.
Profile roles and profile policy are host-owned and cannot be granted by the filter.
Activated add-ons and lifecycle states are restored from the authoritative query after filtering, including continuation refresh and query failure.
Profile identity and tenant scope are revalidated after filtering.
Invalid filtered context falls back to the authoritative context.

extension_points.name: opus.agent.command_runtime.ready
invariants: Observers cannot replace the command processor.
Observers cannot change runtime availability.

extension_points.name: opus.agent.command_runtime.unavailable
invariants: The fail-closed structured result remains authoritative.
Observers cannot force runtime availability or execution.

extension_points.name: opus.conversation.settings
invariants: Mode is constrained to shadow, review, or active.
Required review and privacy exclusions are reapplied after filtering.

extension_points.name: opus.conversation.configuration
invariants: Profile scope, dataset identity, routes, and classifier identity remain authoritative.
Automatic observation stays disabled and generated fallbacks require reviewed promotion.

extension_points.name: opus.frontend.markup_directory
invariants: The directory must remain a nonempty relative path beneath the host resource root.
Theme selection still requires every configured Vibe template and preserves the package default and admin isolation.

boundary_inventory.rationale: Observe bounded operation outcomes while runtime state, identity, effects, authorization and recovery remain service-owned.
Observe a bounded summary after presentation while command authority, result contents and continuation consumption remain service-owned.
Observe sanitized terminal canonical registration results after host policy and effects are settled. Lifecycle mutation, recovery and authoritative state remain service-owned.
Observe committed organization changes while host policy, scope, revision checks, and durable audit remain authoritative.
Defaults may be extended before creation and persisted transitions may be observed without weakening session identity or write guarantees.

boundary_inventory.owner: BlueCore add-on lifecycle contracts and Opus readiness services
boundary_inventory.rationale: Discovery, validation, registration mutation, activation, and removal remain behind lifecycle services, state validation, idempotency, and approval gates. Canonical boot-result observation is catalogued separately.
Context may be augmented within authoritative actor and tenant scope, while runtime availability is observable but not replaceable through actions.
Safe settings and configuration may be extended before mandatory scope, privacy, review, and learning invariants are reapplied.

boundary_inventory.owner: BlueCore routing, request, response, gateway, and controller contracts
boundary_inventory.rationale: Routing, normalization, errors, and audit correlation remain typed service boundaries until stable sanitized payloads and ordering are defined.

boundary_inventory.owner: HostFrontendThemeResolver, Vibe, Vibrato, VibeThemeRenderer, and VibeGenerationService
boundary_inventory.rationale: The host frontend markup directory may be replaced before registration; contained path resolution, template completeness, rendering, and generation remain service contracts with explicit trust boundaries.

boundary_inventory.owner: Opus registration, environment, and scoped policy services
boundary_inventory.rationale: General application, tenant, and principal composition stays closed until authoritative deny and privacy ordering can be guaranteed across settings domains.

boundary_inventory.owner: Agent capability maps, Annex contracts, and future marketplace services
boundary_inventory.rationale: Capability discovery and handoffs remain typed, approval-gated contracts; the marketplace surface is not yet available.
